items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: When I played with Rene? ... he had a, uh, Bad Joe play by the name of Son. You see who else he had.

ctx.x: Yeah, On All The Past. Yeah, On All The Past. And I mixed it with Rene, Sam Morgan. I was having the majority of them afterwards, after I found out I could play, they used me. At that time, they was using Judge E. Parker. You know Judge E. Parker? Uh-huh. And a father by the name of Edward Johnson, he called him as a alias Plitsam. What? Plitsam. Plitsam. Red Caillou, he's also dead. Oh, it's old fellas.
What was Red Caillou's name? Did you know that?
